entities.name: Towabara Plains
entities.description: Massive plains surrounding the Araba and Eiganjo Castle on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Araba
entities.description: Ruined land in Towabara filled with craters from kami attacks.

entities.name: Eiganjo Castle
entities.description: Fortification of daimyo Takeshi Konda in the center of the Araba.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Kami who assaulted the castle during the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which Eiganjo was badly damaged.

entities.name: Yosei
entities.description: The Morning Star who guarded Towabara.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: City that grew across the former Araba.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: Oldest and tallest tree on Kamigawa.

events.summary: During the Kami War, O-Kagachi assaults Eiganjo Castle and badly damages it.
events.quote: the castle was assaulted by O-Kagachi and badly damaged
